newsitem.title: GERMANY: DBV-Winterthur sees 96 group profit rising.
newsitem.headline: DBV-Winterthur sees 96 group profit rising.

text.p: German insurer DBV-Winterthur said on Monday it expected its 1996 group profit to rise more than 30 percent and an earnings per share gain of significantly above 20 percent according to German DVFA accounting standards.
It also said in a statement the expected increase provided room for a dividend increase.

DBV-Winterthur, newly-named after the merger with the German operations of Switzerland's Winterthur in August, said the consolidation of the new activities would result in a strong increase in gross income.
In 1995, the group posted net profit of 75.6 billion marks.
